DLG-SC-LOC-001-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-001-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。列車のご案内でしょうか。どの表示でお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Do you need help with the trains? Which information on the display is unclear?

DLG-SC-LOC-001-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-001-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 小樽まで行きたいんですが、案内に『小樽方面』と『小樽行き』があります。どちらでも小樽まで行けますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 小樽へ行きたいと伝え、小樽方面と小樽行きのどちらも目的地へ着くのか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to go to Otaru, but the board says both “toward Otaru” and “bound for Otaru.” Will either train take me to Otaru?
DLG-SC-LOC-001-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you want to go to Otaru, and ask whether both trains heading toward Otaru and trains bound for Otaru reach your destination.

DLG-SC-LOC-001-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-001-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 『方面』だけでは終点がわかりませんね。乗ろうとしている列車の行き先は、何と書いてありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: “Toward” alone does not tell us the final stop. What destination is shown for the train you plan to take?

DLG-SC-LOC-001-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-001-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 手元のメモには手稲と書いてあります。小樽方面なので、その列車でいいと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 候補のメモは手稲行きだと答え、小樽方面なら小樽へ行けると思っていたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: My note says Teine. Since it is in the direction of Otaru, I thought that train would be fine.
DLG-SC-LOC-001-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Answer in Japanese that your note lists a train bound for Teine, and explain that you thought any train heading toward Otaru would take you to Otaru.

DLG-SC-LOC-001-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-001-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 手稲が終点なら、その列車だけでは小樽まで行けません。小樽まで行く列車を探しますか。それとも途中で乗り換えても構いませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: If Teine is the final stop, that train alone will not take you to Otaru. Would you like to find a train that goes to Otaru, or would changing trains along the way be all right?

DLG-SC-LOC-001-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-001-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 初めてなので、乗り換えずに行ける列車を探したいです。少し待っても構いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 初めてなので乗換えなしを希望し、直通の列車を待ってもよいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: It is my first time, so I would like a train that does not require a transfer. I do not mind waiting a little.
DLG-SC-LOC-001-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that this is your first trip, so you prefer no transfers and are willing to wait for a direct train.

DLG-SC-LOC-001-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-001-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: それなら、発車案内の行き先と停車駅を一緒に確認しましょう。快速という表示があっても、目的地に停まるか確認が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Then let us check the destination and stops on the departure board together. Even if it says “rapid,” you still need to check whether it stops at your destination.

DLG-SC-LOC-001-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-001-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 小樽に停まることが確認できたら、次は同じ列車のホーム番号を見るんですね。似た時刻の列車と取り違えそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 小樽への停車確認後に同じ列車のホームを見ると確認し、似た発車時刻との取り違えが不安だと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Once I have confirmed that it stops at Otaru, I check the platform number for that same train, right? I am worried about confusing it with a train departing at a similar time.
DLG-SC-LOC-001-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese that after checking the train stops at Otaru you will check the platform for that same train, and explain your concern about confusing similar departure times.

DLG-SC-LOC-001-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-001-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。行き先、発車時刻、列車名を同じ行で確認してください。ホームでも列車の表示を照合すると安心です。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Check the destination, departure time and train name on the same row. Checking them against the display on the train at the platform will also help.

DLG-SC-LOC-001-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-001-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: まずこの案内で小樽行きを探し、ホームでも同じ列車か確かめます。表示が変わったら、乗る前に係員に聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 小樽行きを探してホームでも列車を照合し、表示が変われば乗る前に係員へ聞くと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: First I will find a train bound for Otaru on this board, then check at the platform that it is the same train. If the display changes, I will ask a staff member before boarding.
DLG-SC-LOC-001-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will look for a train bound for Otaru, verify the train again on the platform, and ask staff before boarding if the display changes.

DLG-SC-LOC-001-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-001-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その確認方法で大丈夫です。焦って乗らず、わからない時はお声がけください。お気をつけて、いってらっしゃいませ。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: That is a good way to check. Do not rush to board, and please ask us if you are unsure. Have a safe journey!
